purpose: Characterize the exact dual geometry after the linear-autarky kernel and test a tempting positive low-degree UNSAT certificate. Prove that linearly-lean means the signed clause rows positively span the full variable space, equivalently full column rank plus a strictly positive row dependence. Then show on an explicit linearly-lean K4 Tseitin contradiction that nonnegative clause-falsity indicators cannot exactly combine to a positive constant, so first-order balance cannot be promoted to a universal polynomial positive exact-cover certificate.

dual_characterization.matrix: A is the signed clause-variable matrix in {0,+1,-1}^{m by n}.
dual_characterization.theorem: The following are equivalent: (i) {z:Az>=0}={0}; (ii) cone(rows(A))=R^n; (iii) rank(A)=n and there exists y in Q^m with y>0 and A^T y=0.
proof: The cone dual of cone(rows(A)) is exactly {z:Az>=0}. A closed polyhedral cone has dual {0} iff the cone is all of R^n, proving (i)<->(ii).
If cone(rows(A))=R^n, then the rows span R^n. For every row a_i, -a_i is a nonnegative combination of rows; adding one such dependence for every i yields A^T y=0 with every y_i>0.
Conversely, rank(A)=n and A^T y=0 with y_i>0 imply -a_i=sum_{j!=i}(y_j/y_i)a_j for every i. Hence the row cone contains negatives of all generators and is therefore their full linear span R^n.
dual_characterization.interpretation: Every nonempty linearly-lean core has a polynomial-size strictly positive clause weighting that balances total positive and negative weighted occurrence of every variable. In particular m>=n+1.

candidate_positive_exact_cover.clause_falsity: For each width<=3 clause C let f_C:{0,1}^n->{0,1} be 1 exactly on assignments falsifying C, represented by the standard multilinear Boolean polynomial of degree <=3.
candidate_positive_exact_cover.tempting_certificate: Find rational y_C>=0 and alpha>0 such that sum_C y_C f_C(x)=alpha identically on the Boolean cube. This is polynomially checkable by coefficient comparison through degree three and would certify UNSAT because every assignment would falsify positive total clause weight.

explicit_barrier.instance: Odd-charge Tseitin contradiction on K4, with edge variables ordered e01,e02,e03,e12,e13,e23 and vertex charges (1,0,0,0). Each degree-3 XOR equation is encoded by its four forbidden-assignment 3-clauses, for 16 clauses total.
explicit_barrier.linearly_lean_fact: Already one four-clause parity block forces its three linear-autarky coordinates to zero. For charge 1 its signed rows are (+++),(+--),(-+-),(--+); pairwise sums give both z_i>=0 and z_i<=0 for each coordinate. Hence the whole K4 formula has {z:Az>=0}={0}. The all-ones clause weighting also gives A^T 1=0.

three_assignment_functional.property: Direct exact evaluation gives L(f_C) in {0,1} for every one of the 16 clause-falsity indicators, while L(1)=-1.

explicit_barrier.theorem: There do not exist y_C>=0 and alpha>0 with sum_C y_C f_C identically equal to alpha. Applying L would make the left side nonnegative but the right side equal -alpha<0.
explicit_barrier.meaning: Even after matching and linear-autarky preprocessing, UNSAT need not admit a positive exact partition/cover identity using only the original width-3 clause falsity indicators.

positive: Linearly-lean cores come with an exact dual balance certificate useful as a canonical structural normal form.
The K4 Tseitin control remains a compact linearly-lean global-correlation benchmark for every later nonlinear invariant.
killed: Promote the positive dual clause weights of A^T y=0 directly into a universal nonnegative exact-cover identity of clause falsity indicators.
Claim that first-order sign balance plus width-three polynomial coefficient matching is complete for UNSAT.
not_killed: Certificates using products/derived constraints rather than only original f_C.
Nonlinear minimax, topology-changing contraction or compressed high-degree reasoning.

next_target.name: E8_LINEarly_LEAN_SIGNED_DERIVED_CONSTRAINT_CONTRACTION_V4_9
next_target.directive: Do not rely only on nonnegative combinations of original clause indicators. Work on linearly-lean balanced cores and allow signed/global derived constraints, but require polynomial state and exact witness reconstruction. A valid next step must beat both the K4 Tseitin positive-cover functional and the adaptive Macaulay degree barrier without expanding monomials or assignments.
